fourPiece.label: 4 件套全队伤害
fourPiece.conditionText: 装备者为[支援]角色时，发动[强化特殊技]或[终结技]后持续25秒。

fourPieceEffectTexts.en: When the equipper is a Support character and uses an EX Special Attack or Ultimate, the DMG dealt by all squad members increases by 18% for 25s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.
fourPieceEffectTexts.zh-CN: 装备者为[支援]角色时，发动[强化特殊技]或[终结技]会使全队角色造成的伤害提升18%，持续25秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，同名被动效果之间不可叠加。
